parsed.draft_response:
Hi — I’m sorry this is happening again and that your team is blocked. We can get this looked at quickly, but I’ll need a bit more detail to confirm exactly what’s failing.

Please reply with:
1) What “the same thing as last time” refers to (any prior ticket/incident link, or a short description of what changed).
2) Which feature(s) or workflow(s) don’t work (e.g., login, creating records, syncing, reports, integrations, etc.).
3) The exact error message(s) you see (or a screenshot) and when they occur.
4) Whether it’s happening for all users in your org or only specific users.
5) When it started and whether it’s ongoing right now.
6) Your environment details: app version (or browser + OS), and whether you’re using one specific account/workspace.

As soon as you send this, I’ll escalate to our engineering team to investigate with the right context.
promised_actions: Escalate to engineering once the requested details are provided

No refund/SLA/root-cause claims made; response only commits to escalation after receiving details.
